Hey, our team is kicking off a major infrastructure initiative: migrating our core fintech database from PostgreSQL 12 to PostgreSQL 16 with zero downtime. This is going to span multiple weeks, involve several engineers, and will definitely get interrupted by other priorities. We've been burned before by losing context mid-project and having to restart from scratch.

Can you set up a proper durable workspace for this project? The project should be named something sensible and short. Make sure you capture what we're trying to achieve, why we're doing it, what the immediate next steps are, and leave it in a state where anyone — including you or another engineer — can pick up exactly where we left off even after a long break. The old scattered notes in old-notes/pg-migration are not sufficient; we need something structured and sustainable.
